lines.en: I'm Peppa Pig. This is my little brother, George. This is Mummy Pig. And this is Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 我是小猪佩奇。这是我的弟弟乔治，这是猪妈妈，这是猪爸爸。

lines.en: Grandpa Pig's Boat. Granny Pig and Grandpa Pig are taking Peppa and George out for a day on the river.
lines.zh: 猪爷爷的船。猪奶奶和猪爷爷要带佩奇和乔治去河上玩一天。

lines.en: Welcome aboard, me hearties! Peppa, George, let's put your life jackets on.
lines.zh: 欢迎登船，我的小水手们！佩奇，乔治，来把救生衣穿上。

lines.en: When Peppa and George are on Grandpa Pig's boat, they must wear life jackets. On this boat, I'm the captain! Aye aye, Captain! Aye aye, Captain!
lines.zh: 佩奇和乔治坐猪爷爷的船时，必须穿上救生衣。在这条船上，我就是船长！遵命，船长！遵命，船长！

lines.en: When Captain Grandpa tells you all to do something, you must do it, unless it's something silly.
lines.zh: 当船长爷爷吩咐你们做什么事，你们就必须做，除非那事很傻。

lines.en: Captain Grandpa never says anything silly! Of course not! Captain Grandpa!
lines.zh: 船长爷爷从来不说傻话！那是当然！船长爷爷！

lines.en: George, raise the flag!
lines.zh: 乔治，升旗！

lines.en: Peppa, ring the bell! Aye aye, Captain! Granny Pig, take the wheel! Aye aye, Captain!
lines.zh: 佩奇，敲铃！遵命，船长！猪奶奶，掌舵！遵命，船长！

lines.en: Full sail!
lines.zh: 全速前进！

lines.en: Maybe you should go a little slower, Grandpa Pig! Good idea, Granny Pig, I don't want to use up all my petrol!
lines.zh: 猪爷爷，也许你该开慢一点！猪奶奶，好主意，我可不想把汽油全用光！

lines.en: Grandpa, I liked it when we went fast! Don't worry, Peppa, we'll go fast later.
lines.zh: 爷爷，我喜欢刚才开得快的时候！别担心，佩奇，我们待会儿再开快。

lines.en: Look, there's another boat! Here's Granddad Dog. He's taking Danny Dog out for a day on the river.
lines.zh: 看，还有一条船！是狗爷爷。他正带小狗丹尼去河上玩一天。

lines.en: Ahoy there, Granddad Dog! Ahoy there, Grandpa Pig! Hello, Danny!
lines.zh: 你好啊，狗爷爷！你好啊，猪爷爷！你好，丹尼！

lines.en: Hello, Peppa! Granddad Dog is Grandpa Pig's very best friend.
lines.zh: 你好，佩奇！狗爷爷是猪爷爷最好的朋友。

lines.en: I'm surprised your boat is still afloat, Granddad Dog. It must be almost as old as you are!
lines.zh: 狗爷爷，我很惊讶你这船居然还浮得起来。它大概跟你一样老了吧！

lines.en: This old boat can go faster than your rusty bucket any day, Grandpa Pig!
lines.zh: 猪爷爷，我这艘老船哪天都比你那艘锈桶跑得快！

lines.en: All right, you old sea dog, race you! Prepare to lose, water hog!
lines.zh: 好吧，你这老水狗，跟你比一场！准备认输吧，水耗子！

lines.en: You two are acting like little children!
lines.zh: 你们俩简直像小孩子一样！

lines.en: Granddad Dog called me a water hog! You called him a sea dog first! Grandpa, you should say sorry! Only if he says sorry first! Granddad, say sorry to Grandpa Pig, he is your best friend!
lines.zh: 狗爷爷骂我是水耗子！是你先叫他老水狗的！爷爷，你应该道歉！除非他先道歉！狗爷爷，跟猪爷爷道歉，他是你最好的朋友呀！

lines.en: No! He's a water hog, and my boat is faster than his! All right, sea dog, let's race to the next bridge! On the count of three! One, two... go!
lines.zh: 不！他就是水耗子，而且我的船比他的快！好吧，老水狗，我们比赛到下一座桥！数到三开始！一、二……出发！

lines.en: You started too soon! Catch me if you can, water hog! Sea dog, is that as fast as you can go?
lines.zh: 你抢跑了！有本事就追上我，水耗子！老水狗，你就这点速度吗？

lines.en: Can't catch me!
lines.zh: 追不上我！

lines.en: I win! Oh, dear, Grandpa Pig's boat has run out of petrol. Very clever, Captain Grandpa! Maybe I did go a bit too fast!
lines.zh: 我赢啦！哦，天哪，猪爷爷的船没油了。真聪明啊，船长爷爷！也许我确实开得太快了点！

lines.en: How will we get home? Look, there's Granddad Dog! Granddad Dog, can tow us home?
lines.zh: 那我们怎么回家呢？看，是狗爷爷！狗爷爷，能把我们拖回家吗？

lines.en: I'm not being towed by that sea dog! I haven't offered to tow the water hog!
lines.zh: 我才不要被那只老水狗拖着走！我又没说过要拖那只水耗子！

lines.en: Will you two ever grow up? Grandpa, say sorry to Granddad Dog!
lines.zh: 你们俩什么时候才能长大呀？爷爷，跟狗爷爷道歉！

lines.en: I'm sorry I called you a sea dog, Granddad. Say sorry to Grandpa Pig!
lines.zh: 对不起，我不该叫你老水狗，狗爷爷。跟猪爷爷道歉！

lines.en: I'm sorry I called you a water hog.
lines.zh: 对不起，我不该叫你水耗子。

lines.en: That's nice. Granddad Dog, would you be so kind as to tow us home? It would be my pleasure, madame! Catch this, Captain! Aye aye, Skipper!
lines.zh: 这样就对了。狗爷爷，麻烦你把我们拖回家好吗？乐意效劳，女士！接住绳子，船长！遵命，船老大！

lines.en: Granddad Dog is Grandpa Pig's very best friend. Granddad Dog is towing Grandpa Pig's boat home.
lines.zh: 狗爷爷是猪爷爷最好的朋友。狗爷爷正把猪爷爷的船拖回家。

lines.en: The main thing is... aye... I won the race, Grandpa Pig! Naughty Grandpa Pig!
lines.zh: 重要的是……哎呀……我赢了比赛，猪爷爷！调皮的猪爷爷！

lines.en: Peppa, ring the bell! Aye aye, Captain Grandpa!
lines.zh: 佩奇，敲铃！遵命，船长爷爷！
